title: Harmony checker misranks single-voice timbre auditions
description: Confirmed by reproducing CLI output: isolated voices A/B/C receive consonance 86.71/93.22/95.30 despite this being an inappropriate timbre ranking. check.rs selects the first event-bearing stem as bass, including a sole melody and unordered multiple candidates. Cross-stem clash is zero here; the remaining penalty is bass-semitone energy, not clarity. Removing event metadata from unchanged C audio raises its score to 100. Render metadata also loses written chords when harmonic solver fit is absent, disabling target/coverage context. Repair bass identification and harmony metadata; expose metric components and applicability. Separate expected-pitch accuracy, stability and broadband descriptors from musical taste. The original A/B/C comparison also changed register, lengths and effects; controlled same-MIDI experiments and synthetic checks are recorded in the investigation comment. Do not add a generic within-stem noise/self-clash quality penalty.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Investigation completed; no production analyzer changes yet. Independently reproduced C95.298 versus identical audio without events100. Confirmed first event-bearing stem is forced into bass role and written chord metadata vanishes without solver fit. Raw spectral flatness50–4000Hz A0.0000027/B0.0241/C0.0435 supports greater broadband content in original C; A has only1.14% energy near its first8 declared C4 harmonics, suggesting unreliable root/polyphonic source rather than merely noise. Original drafts used different MIDI, durations and effects. New controlled auditions compile identical D3 E3 C3 C2 G2 at0/2/4/6/8s with1s durations and matched envelopes/effects/loudness. Original C cannot fit that register under +/-24semitones; C2 explicitly substitutes hold-9 Eb2. Synthetic clean sine, mismatched-pitch sine, and noise checks at each root pass; descriptors are not a taste score. C2 rendered tuning30–35c low versus raw5c low needs separate manifest-correction investigation. Local report: renders/signal-investigation/controlled/REPORT.md; diagnostic script and JSON alongside it. Acceptance behaviors for repair: solo melody must not automatically count as bass; repeated multi-track checks must agree; written chord context must survive no solver-fit voices; report zero/nonapplicable cross-stem clash explicitly; pitch mismatch must remain distinct from noisy timbre. Bug remains in_progress until repairs land.
